en.title: Four-panel character story
en.description: Consistent original characters act out four clear story beats.
en.body:
## How to use

Describe the cast and supply exactly four ordered story beats; a character sheet is optional.

Read the panels in order and check each character remains recognizable.

## Recorded result

The example was generated with the built-in image tool. Its exact model ID was not returned. The recorded run contains the submitted prompt and ordered inputs.

## 使用方法

准备：角色描述和四个故事节点；角色参考图可选。原创角色以一致造型演绎四个清楚的故事节点。

## 实测结果

样例由内置图像工具生成，工具未返回精确模型 ID。运行记录保存实际提交的提示词与有序参考图。本站人物、房间、宠物和服饰参考均为原创合成素材。
